candidates.change_summary: Replace the require checking exact msg.value with a check that allows smaller payment by requiring msg.value >= TICKET_AMOUNT, which can change pot accumulation and thus pot after play.
Change the increment of pot to add only TICKET_AMOUNT instead of msg.value, altering pot when msg.value differs (e.g., due to changed require), affecting pot after play.
Change the branch condition to trigger payout when random == 1 instead of 0, which moves when pot is reset and thus observable.
Move the pot reset (pot = 0) to before transferring funds, which can change pot observable after play due to reentrancy or transfer failure semantics.
Remove the pot reset so pot is never set to 0 on a win, changing pot observed after play.
Change the fee transfer to send zero instead of FEE_AMOUNT, altering pot after play and thus observable pot value.
Change the conditional to trigger on random == 1 instead of random == 0, flipping when pot is paid out and thus changing observed pot.
Transfer the entire pot to the bank instead of fee, leaving pot at 0 after play and changing observed pot.
Remove the line that resets pot to 0, so pot remains funded after payout and changes observed pot value.
Change pot increment to add FEE_AMOUNT instead of msg.value, altering pot's value after play.
